meta.title: End Timestamp
meta.description: Inlines the concrete end date/time, the elapsed duration and the serving model into DSH's reply line: the timestamp/model sit at the end (ended at YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS ｜ provider/model), while the duration follows the state word in the same spot as 'done, took …'; turns where DSH hides the duration (stopped, failed) also show it.
